name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project, located in the prolific Walker Lane gold trend approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington, Nevada. The company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and a $5M Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement for a 50% interest in the project with Walker River Resources. A 2025 reverse circulation drill program returned high-grade intercepts including 3.79 g/t Au over 85 m, with an initial NI 43-101 resource estimate targeted for 2026.
